Working Principles

Ideas shaped by experience. Not rules for everyone—simply principles I try to return to.

PRINCIPLE 01

Relationships Before Transactions

The immediate deal matters. The relationship that remains after it matters more.

PRINCIPLE 02

Curiosity Before Certainty

Certainty can end a conversation. Curiosity gives it somewhere to go.

PRINCIPLE 03

The Contract Is the Beginning

The signature records an agreement. What happens afterwards determines its value.

PRINCIPLE 04

Share Credit Generously

Good work becomes stronger when people feel their contribution was seen.

PRINCIPLE 05

Make Working With You Easier

Reliability is often remembered more clearly than brilliance.

PRINCIPLE 06

Listen Before Leading

Direction improves when it begins with an honest understanding of where people are.
